verdict.rationale: Morph is an API platform, so scoped agent credentials are a fair question to ask. The evidence describes only a single bearer API key that 'covers' all models and tools, with no documented per-key scopes, permission restrictions, or least-privilege key issuance. The OpenAPI mention of 'credits and budgets' is a spending control, not credential scoping, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
